title: Molotov
description: Adds a realistic Molotov cocktail to the game.
body:
# adds a throwable Molotov cocktail to Minecraft.

### Crafting
You can craft it using a **Fire Charge**, **Paper**, and **a Glass Bottle.**

![Crafting recipe for the Molotov cocktail in Minecraft.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/467922ec6ed48c36e47aaf167e91ac90c0adad06.png)

### How to Use
1. **Right-click** with the Molotov item to throw it.
2. It explodes and creates fire instantly upon impact with blocks or entities.

### Installation
1. **Download** the datapack zip file.
2. Put the file into your Minecraft world's **`datapacks` folder**.
3. Type **`/reload`** in the game chat.
